verdict.rationale: Docs show terminal ordering via API/Customer Area and marketing claims like 'Get started fast' (adyen-pos-docs-11, adyen-pos-docs-25), but there's no evidence of a self-serve signup/approval dashboard flow for founders, and a hands-on account describes 'hundreds of hours invested' integrating with Adyen's POS/COM system before abandoning it for Stripe, directly contradicting a same-week setup claim. missing for 10: evidence of self-serve merchant onboarding/approval timeline, dashboard-based signup flow, and independent confirmation of fast time-to-first-transaction.
